# asc_vm_group (Resource)

Manages a virtual machine group in the DSPC platform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a virtual machine group
resource "asc_vm_group" "example" {
  name   = "my-example-vm-group"
  sku_id = "medium"
  vpc_id = "vpc-id"
  image  = "vm-image"

  tags = {
    environment = "production"
    team        = "platform"
  }

  autoscaling_policy = {
    min_replicas = 1
    max_replicas = 5

    cron = {
      timezone         = "UTC"
      start            = "0 8 * * *"
      end              = "0 18 * * *"
      desired_replicas = 3
    }
  }

  customization = {
    cloud_init = {
      user_data = <<-EOT
        #cloud-config
        hostname: my-example-vm-group
      EOT
    }
  }

}

# Output the VMGroup details
output "vmg_urn" {
  description = "The URN of the created virtual machine group"
  value       = asc_vm_group.example.urn
}

output "vmg_name" {
  description = "The name of the created virtual machine group"
  value       = asc_vm_group.example.name
}

output "vmg_status" {
  description = "The current status of the virtual machine group"
  value       = asc_vm_group.example.status
}

output "vmg_attached_volumes" {
  description = "The volumes attached to the virtual machine group"
  value       = asc_vm_group.example.attached_volumes
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the virtual machine group. Must be unique within the platform.
- `sku_id` (String) The SKU ID defining the VMGroup size/type (e.g. "gp-2").
- `vpc_id` (String) The ID of the VPC to launch the virtual machine group in.

### Optional

- `autoscaling_policy` (Attributes) The autoscaling policy configured for the virtual machine group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling_policy))
- `customization` (Attributes) Optional VMGroup customization data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customization))
- `image` (String) The OS image to use for the virtual machine group.
- `tags` (Map of String) User defined tags attached to the virtual machine group.

### Read-Only

- `attached_volumes` (List of String) The list of volume names attached to the virtual machine group.
- `last_error` (String) The last error encountered during CRUD of the virtual machine group.
- `sku` (Attributes) The full SKU details for the virtual machine. group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sku))
- `status` (String) The current status of the virtual machine group.
- `urn` (String) The uniform resource name for the virtual machine group.

Required:

Optional:

- `cron` (Attributes) Cron-based scheduling configuration for scaling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--autoscaling_policy--cron))

Required:

- `timezone` (String) The timezone the cron schedule is evaluated in.
